checks.message: Verify the volume is not crossing environment boundaries
checks.context: Attaching a volume from a production instance to a dev instance exposes sensitive data across environment boundaries. Confirm the target instance is in the correct environment.

checks.message: EBS volume deletion is permanent. Snapshot first if the data matters
checks.context: Deleted EBS volumes cannot be recovered. AWS does not guarantee data is wiped before storage is reallocated. If the volume contained sensitive data, create a final snapshot for compliance purposes.

checks.message: Volume modifications have a 6-hour cooldown, and you can't modify again until it expires
checks.context: After modifying a volume, you must wait 6 hours before modifying it again. Plan capacity changes carefully because you can't immediately undo an accidental size increase.

checks.message: This only applies to new volumes. Existing unencrypted volumes are not affected
checks.context: Enabling default encryption doesn't retroactively encrypt existing volumes. Snapshot each existing unencrypted volume and restore it with encryption enabled to cover your full EBS footprint.
